notes.title: Wales Interactive Limited Edition Bundle is on Mid Week Madness!
notes.content:
We have a special Wales Interactive Limited Edition Bundle for Steam's Mid-Week Madness! Grab your award-winning favourites at a limited-time discount; including Late Shift, Five Dates, The Complex and Maid of Sker

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/16665/Wales_Interactive_Limited_Edition/

Late Shift
Late Shift is a high stakes FMV crime thriller. Forced into a brutal London heist, your choices matter in this interactive cinematic experience with adaptable storylines that lead to one of seven conclusions. Your decisions are you.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XlfCRV1j_v4

Five Dates 
Five Dates is an interactive rom-com about the unpredictable world of digital dating. With five potential female matches, Vinny explores whether compatibility, chemistry and connection is still possible in a world where physical touch is no longer an option.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=K8l3PDkRsic

The Complex
After a major bio-weapon attack on London, two scientists find themselves in a locked-down laboratory with time, and air, running out. The Complex is an interactive sci-fi thriller movie where your decisions lead to one of eight suspenseful endings.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1flPHceAsXY

Maid of Sker
Maid of Sker is a first-person survival horror, set in a remote hotel with a gory and macabre history from British folklore. Armed with only a defensive sound device, you’ll utilise stealth tactics to avoid death amongst a cult of sound-based AI enemies. Try the Challenge Mode if you're brave enough!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8I2d0uk7u5c

Come on over to our Official Discord for exclusive news and rewards! 

Please check out the Steam dev blogs, the official game page, and the complete press kit, and don't forget to follow us on Twitter for up-to-date news.

Don't forget to wishlist and follow Maid of Sker's spiritual successor Sker Ritual!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1492070/Sker_Ritual/

notes.title: Maid of Sker | Make Your Reservation at Sker Hotel on July 28
notes.content:
Make your Reservation at the Sker Hotel! 

 Join us for the hotel's Grand Re-opening on July 28th, pre-order from July 21st on PC, PS4 and Xbox One. 

Introducing the new trailer for Maid of Sker featuring the spine-chilling voice of Tia Kalmaru with a re-imagining of a traditional Welsh lullaby Calon Lan.

Maid of Sker is a first-person survival horror, set in a remote hotel with a gory and macabre history from British folklore. At Sker Hotel we offer grotesque views, eerie forest trails, and blood-soaked beds. Be our guest but watch your step, make a sound and the Quiet Ones welcome you.

[previewyoutube=Ewkx5eBlOEs;full]https://youtu.be/yiC7Z7Ih27I [/previewyoutube]

[previewyoutube=8I2d0uk7u5c;full][/previewyoutube]

Now you've seen sound devices in use, you've seen the breathing mechanic, the sound-based AI enemies, the inventory system... now we'd like to share a few details on the save system (a common question we receive!)

Yes, you can manually save your game via our Phonographs.

We welcome you to indulge in the use of the Phonographs, a device for the mechanical recording and reproduction of sound. Invented by Thomas Edison, the American inventor who gave us the Electric light bulb, it transitioned into the gramophone, which led to what we still use today — the vinyl record player.

Our Phonographs offer safety, allowing you to catch your breath and save your game, listen to the recordings and unlock the mysteries lurking within the Sker Hotel. 

Upgrade your stay by adding the game to your Steam Wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/826940

Now the gates are opening, we will see you soon.

Wales Interactive

Web: https://www.walesinteractive.com/maidofsker
Twitter: https://twitter.com/WalesInter
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/WalesInteractive

notes.title: The Complex interactive movie is out now!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=1flPHceAsXY;full][/previewyoutube]

The Complex is OUT NOW! 

From the publishing studio behind Late Shift, comes a new cinematic interactive sci-fi thriller movie for PC, Mac, PS4, Xbox One and Switch.

After a major bio-weapon attack on London, two scientists find themselves in a locked-down laboratory with time, and air, running out. With choose-your-own-path style gameplay, your actions and your relationship with other characters will lead you to one of eight suspenseful endings.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36752512/503b73e604e8a4e37b36d1bb895242ca0dcb79bb.jpg

We want to thank everyone for their support in the build-up to the launch. With just hours of being released, we've had some incredible reviews which we'd like to share with you :)

9.5/10 – God is Geek
“Story is fantastically written, acting is brilliant and multiple endings massively help with replayability.”

9/10 – Digitally Downloaded
“Phenomenal cast, complicated characters, a deep and rather dark narrative.”
 
8/10 – Gamespew
“A sharp, smartly written interactive thriller, with not a single one-dimensional character in sight, The Complex is (despite its theme) a joy to experience.” 

9/10 – Hooked Gamers
“Wales Interactive has earned itself a reputation for being the bar to be measured by in the interactive movie genre, and I can’t wait to see where they go with it next.”

9/10 – Adventure Gamers
“Once The Complex enters full-on thriller mode, this compelling choice-driven tale of a trapped scientist facing terrorists and moral decisions doesn’t let up and even provides enough prompting and interesting options to weather multiple plays.”

That's it for now! We'll update you again very soon. In the meantime... how are you, the Steam community, finding our latest interactive movie? We want to hear YOUR thoughts!

notes.title: The Shapeshifting Detective FMV is out now!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25721079/5ee3dc1d47bcd14dedab8cd5664dc6a717a10c3e.jpg

The Shapeshifting Detective — a supernatural murder mystery FMV game from D'Avekki Studios, the creators of The Infectious Madness of Doctor Dekker, is out now on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/898650/

In The Shapeshifting Detective you play as Sam - a detective with the ability to (you guessed it) shapeshift! 

Dorota Shaw is dead. And the prime suspects are three tarot readers with the uncanny ability to predict murder - or commit it. It’s your job to find out what else they know - but they won’t reveal their dark secrets to just anyone… Luckily, you can be anyone you want to be. Even the next victim.

Featuring more than 1600 full HD video responses, a randomly chosen murderer and guest starring Rupert Booth (Contraditcion), Anarosa De Eizaguirre Butler (Contradiction) and Aislinn De’Ath (The Infectious Madness of Doctor Dekker). 

FEATURES
- 1600+ full HD FMV videos.
- A large multi-location, multi-suspect world to explore.
- Shapeshift into nine other characters, or be yourself.
- Branching storyline and randomly chosen murderer for high replayability.
- In-game radio station featuring short dark fiction plays between visits.
- Any one of three random murderers helps to minimize spoilers.
- Shapeshift and your dialogue options are voiced by the original actors.
- Not all branching is binary. Push someone too far and discover a different reaction.
- Can’t get that vital clue yourself? Shapeshift into the Police Chief!
- Think your options are a trap? Refuse to speak to potentially unlock a hidden path.

notes.title: Late Shift Audience Voting now on Mixer!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28053821/f4de5e988dd6a912d240d45367810c034e3c8a2d.jpg

Cast your votes!

Creating history on Mixer (Mixtory?) with interactive live-action movies and FMV games that puts the audience in control! To celebrate the 1-year anniversary of Mixer, streamers will now have the chance to pass over the controls with the all-new audience voting system in the award-winning FMV crime thriller, Late Shift. 

The audience’s choices will have consequences from the very start, right through to the very end. One small decision could change the entire outcome in a choose-your-own-adventure style gameplay with adaptable storylines that can lead to one of seven conclusions.

Starting today on PC (Steam) and Xbox One, Mixer audiences can vote on every single decision made throughout the game—and there is over 180 in total to be made! The streaming host also gets a vote but can in no way force the outcome themselves in a majority rule voting scenario. Anyone can access the Mixer interactive feature from the main menu. 

New Languages

Additionally, we have even more language support added to the game! Late Shift can now be played in Polish and Ukrainian. A special thanks to Marcin Serwin and Vasyl Atamaniuk from the community for providing the translations!

Don’t forget you can follow Wales Interactive on our Twitter and Facebook page. 

Wales Interactive Team

notes.title: Content Update: New Audio Sliders
notes.content:
http://i.imgur.com/0Yonr2U.gif

Hi everyone! First of all we'd like to give a huge thank you to everyone who has supported the game since the launch and to all those who have been sending us feedback to help improve the game. We really appreciate the time you've taken to join us in the forums to let us know what you think. 

Since the launch, we have been able to add additional languages that were requested and rest assured, we will be adding more of those top requested  languages very soon! 

One of the main requests we've received is to add an additional slider to have more control over the music and dialogue, primarily for some users who are experiencing low dialogue levels. We are happy to announce we have now added an additional volume slider which can be found in the main menu settings as well as the in-game options menu. 

We'd love to hear your feedback on this so feel free to leave a comment below or head over to the main forum! 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/584980/

If anyone is experiencing any issues in the game that can't be resolved by this thread, then please contact us. 

If you'd like to further support the developers then you can do so by letting other know what you think of Late Shift in the review section.

You can also follow our Facebook and Twitter pages to stay up to date with all our news. 

Thank you once again from all the team at Wales Interactive.

notes.title: Late Shift - A Cinematic FMV Crime Thriller
notes.content:
http://i.imgur.com/geri9F8.jpg 

FMV IS BACK
Hello everyone! It feels like a lifetime since we have been active on Steam. I can tell you we’ve been keeping very busy, with our new publishing label and of course, developing some new IP (more to reveal on that at a later date). We were also responsible for the development of the FMV horror game, The Bunker, along with our partners are Splendy Games (If you haven’t played that then you’ve been missing out on the rebirth of FMV!)

We’re finally back with a brand new FMV game – LATE SHIFT   with 20% off pre-order discount starting today.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/584980

 http://i.imgur.com/F4eV1jR.png 
 http://i.imgur.com/PnsG82D.png 
 http://i.imgur.com/8y5I9GS.png 

Late Shift is a high stakes FMV crime thriller with branching storylines. After being forced into the robbery of a lucrative auction house, mathematics student Matt is left proving his innocence in the brutal London heist. The consequences of his actions take him on a vicious and violent journey across the capital, escaping the twisted web the player has the power to weave.

Developed by our good friends at CtrlMovie and written by Michael R. Johnson, author of Sherlock Holmes (2009 film), experience a gripping live-action crime thriller with a total of over 180 decision points. 

DECISIONS, DECISIONS… 

Your choices will have consequences from the very start, right through to the very end. One small decision could change the entire outcome in a choose-your-own-adventure style gameplay that can lead to one of seven conclusions.

 http://i.imgur.com/6Bf57uu.png 
 http://i.imgur.com/5Pjcd1V.png 
 http://i.imgur.com/o5Svry9.png 

Do you steal the car or do you run away? Do you follow orders or sabotage the plan? You’ll have just seconds to decide as the film continues to roll with no pauses and no looping footage.

PRE-ORDER…AND DISCOUNTS 

To celebrate the launch we’re able to offer you a chance to pre-order the game with a 20% discount! That drops the price to under $10 starting from today!

Don’t forget you can follow Wales Interactive on our Twitter and Facebook page. Thank you all so much for reading and if you have any comments, please leave them below.

Wales Interactive Team
